name: TinyZKP Platform Rollout
summary: Sales-assisted rollout package for agent platforms, workflow engines, IDEs, and marketplaces that want TinyZKP proof receipts as a native policy surface.
audience: Automation platforms with high-value state-changing tool calls

commercial_model.starting_package: From $499/month committed minimum plus usage after pilot or design review.
commercial_model.recommended_first_step: $5,000 production pilot for one scoped workflow, creditable toward annual or reserved-capacity agreement if converted within 60 days.
commercial_model.usage_model: Self-serve proof receipt and Compute usage rates apply unless a reserved-capacity agreement supersedes them.
commercial_model.verification: Receipt verification is free for recipients.

offer.primary_outcome: Launch one receipt-required tool category with a clear TinyZKP proof statement, verifier path, receipt envelope, support expectation, and expansion plan.
included: Receipt policy design for one platform tool category or workflow checkpoint
Receipt envelope and schema guidance for agent outputs, logs, dashboards, and audit records
Verifier placement and user-facing copy review
not_included_by_default: Custom proof systems outside the supported TinyZKP receipt boundary

rollout_phases.goal: Pick one high-value action class where receipt evidence replaces weak logs, screenshots, approvals, or manual reconciliation.
Use the $5,000 pilot to prove one real workflow, receipt statement, verifier path, and cost range.
Expose receipt-required behavior in product UI, agent policy, logs, marketplace requirements, or customer dashboards.
Add adjacent tool categories, customer-facing receipt surfaces, audit exports, reserved capacity, or Compute planning.

distribution_hooks: Receipt-required policy for durable state-changing agent actions
Receipt URL shown beside agent output, logs, workflow checkpoints, or customer dashboards
Agent marketplace category requirement for payments, records, permissions, quotas, and operational state
Free verification for customers, auditors, counterparties, and downstream agents
Machine-readable receipt envelopes for agent-to-agent handoffs
technical_requirements: MCP or REST integration path for prove, poll, fetch, summarize, and verify operations
Supported receipt statement or pilot-reviewed custom statement
No secrets, API keys, or private customer data in transparent receipt parameters
Storage of proof job IDs or receipt URLs beside platform workflow checkpoints
Verifier URL or receipt envelope returned with the final agent output
success_metrics: One receipt-required category launches with clear user-facing value
Recipients can verify without an API key
Receipt cost and monthly caps are understood before production expansion
Support and escalation path are agreed before customer-visible rollout
Adjacent receipt categories are identified after the first category proves value
